_comment: Drives the Recovery Parameters pane's three combo boxes (Recovery Type / Recovery Plan / Data Source) in VCFRecoveryCoordinatorUI.xaml/.ps1. Edit this file to add a new recovery plan, relabel one, change which data sources it permits, or repoint it at a different plan/variables JSON file -- no PowerShell/XAML changes needed for any of that. A brand-new plan must still reuse one of the existing 'target' values below (each is tied to a specific piece of already-built UI plumbing); adding a genuinely new kind of target is a code change, not a JSON one.
_targetComment: target is one of: managementDomain | workloadDomain | additionalCluster | fleetComponent | recoverFleet -- see Sync-RecoveryPlanSelection in the .ps1 for what each one does. Exactly one plan should claim a given target; two plans claiming the same one will fight over the same panel. Optional engineeringOnlyClusterTypes (additionalCluster plan only) lists raw primaryDatastoreType values (e.g. VSAN_MAX = Storage Cluster, VSAN_Remote = Compute Cluster) whose clusters need engineering mode to be selected.
_extraToggleComment: extraToggleDefinitions defines every optional plan-specific toggle once (id + label), the same way recoveryTypes/dataSources are defined once above. A plan opts in to a toggle by listing its id + defaultChecked under its own extraToggles array; the toggle's id doubles as the variable name injected into step-condition evaluation and is excluded from that plan's persisted answers file.

extraToggleDefinitions.label: User Provided VCF Operations Restore Script

_extraRadioGroupComment: extraRadioGroupDefinitions defines every optional plan-specific group of mutually exclusive radio buttons once. Each option has an id, a label and a 'variables' map of pseudo-variable name -> 'true'/'false' string that is injected into step-condition evaluation while that option is selected (never written to the answers file). Each group also has a 'label' (frame header) and optional 'tooltip'. A plan opts in by listing the group id + defaultOption under its own extraRadioGroups array.

extraRadioGroupDefinitions.label: Binary Sourcing
extraRadioGroupDefinitions.tooltip: Where recovery binaries come from: the authorized offline depot plus the original VCF Installer, or an unauthorized offline depot with manual binary staging.

options.label: Authorized Offline Depot & Original VCF Installer
